title: Ultrasound-driven nitrogen oxidation: a sonoelectrochemical pathway to ammonia synthesis boosted by contact-electro-catalysis
content: Ultrasound activates N2, forming reactive NO2− and NO3− intermediates that are electrochemically reduced to NH3. Integrating ultrasound with contact-electro-catalysis significantly enhances N2 activation and NH3 yield, offering a simple pathway for sustainable NH3 synthesis.
